title: Mathership день рождения — Birthday/Happy-Place, Crystal, Preservation and Abomination Forensics

canonical_key_phrases.phrase_1: This was the spot where the birthday stuff would pop up
canonical_key_phrases.preservation_rule: These strings must remain verbatim in future descendants; interpretation must be stored separately from literal text.

facts: DLC05MZ1AbductionHappy is declared as a short state variable.
Its adjacent comment describes it as incremented while happy-place objects are swapped.
At DLC05AbductionTimer <= 12 the script enters the retained timing slot and sets DLC05MZ1AbductionHappy from 0 to 1.
The developer comment explicitly says this was where birthday material would appear and that surrounding timing code was retained for pain SFX.
The currently preserved decompiled script no longer contains the actual birthday-object swap implementation.
script_residue_analysis.forensic_interpretation: The strongest reading is removed/disabled visual-memory content whose timing residue survived. The script establishes a former birthday/happy-place presentation layer during the examination, but not the exact object set.

hidden_message_audit.goal: Test whether the two preserved phrases themselves contain a reproducible cryptographic/encoding payload comparable to a prior Morse-style audit.
tested_transforms: word lengths mapped directly to A1Z26 letters
forward/reverse forms without introducing an external key
why_not_promoted: Acrostics and telestics do not yield stable English or known Fallout/JANUS identifiers.
Word-length parity can be partitioned into Morse letters in many arbitrary ways, so any readable output would be selection-dependent.
No delimiter/key supplied by the script selects one partition or extraction over alternatives.
The semantic content of the comments already has a direct development explanation and therefore outranks speculative cryptography.
hidden_message_audit.allowed_hidden_message_claim: A semantic hidden layer is strongly supported: a painful alien examination was designed to be interrupted/overlaid by 'happy place' birthday imagery. A separate cryptographic message inside the English comments is not established.

support: It is the Lone Wanderer's canonical tenth-birthday sequence.
CG02 contains party sounds, repeated Happy Birthday dialogue, gifts and party objects.
The script comment says birthday, not birth.
Both CG00 and the Zeta sequence place the protagonist in a low-agency medical/procedural bodily threshold.
Point Lookout independently fuses Catherine/mother/birth trauma, an operating table, party balloons and hallucination imagery.
candidate_B_CG00_birth.boundary: No direct CG00 object reference has been recovered from DLC05MZ1QuestScript.

support: happy-place object swapping is named in the state comment
birthday material was explicitly intended to pop up during the examination timer
the actual swap code is absent, consistent with removed content leaving timing residue

birthday_candidate_resolution.current_best_model: CG02-derived or CG02-like autobiographical birthday imagery was intended as a brief happy-place/hallucination overlay during the alien examination; exact object lineage remains unresolved.

cg02.count_context: Amata brings four hats for the Lone Wanderer's tenth birthday

mothership_zeta.count_context: Four party hats are present in Mothership Zeta Cargo Hold among collected pre-War Earth objects

four_hat_parallel.interpretation: Raises the priority of an exact asset-lineage search but cannot by itself prove that the Cargo Hold hats were the removed AbductionHappy objects.

point_lookout_control.finding: A shipped Fallout 3 hallucination places the Lone Wanderer's mother/Catherine representation on an operating table surrounded by party balloons; a party-hat/birthday object is also associated with this altered-state sequence.
point_lookout_control.importance: This independently demonstrates a Fallout 3 visual grammar in which birthday imagery can coexist with medical procedure, mother/birth trauma and hallucinated autobiographical material.

preservation_signals: Somah explicitly reasons that the aliens have kept the captives alive for a reason and will intervene if a staged fistfight appears life-threatening.
Alien guards do intervene in the staged fight, enabling the escape plan.
The ship contains long-term cryostasis capable of preserving abductees across centuries.
Alien workers are behaviorally harmless and flee/cower; Sally asks the player not to hurt them.
A terrified alien later pleads for its life and is killed by Paulson, demonstrating that not every Zetan encountered is an attacking combatant.
coercion_and_harm_signals: Standard alien soldiers are hostile and armed.
Captive logs document shocks, invasive procedures, mutilation and experimentation.
Log 19 reports that many captives died from experiments.
Log 20 documents removal of a captive's arms.
Log 10 documents Frank after transformation into an abomination.
The ship possesses a death ray and security weapons.
Cargo disposal can destroy living terrestrial specimens.

confirmed: Alien squid food is explicitly described as food used by aliens.
Alien worm food also serves as alien food.
Both are edible by the player and cause no radiation/adverse effect in ordinary gameplay.
alien_food.interpretation: Their diet is mundane/biological rather than evidence that Zetans are non-threatening. Diet has no demonstrated causal relation to the abduction program.

confirmed_distribution: Found on some aliens and on tables/shelves among alien artifacts.
A DLC05 alien-technology test cell places small crystals together with alien epoxy, squid food and a healing archway.
Another test cell contains large/small alien crystals alongside cut prototype gemstone/device miscellany.
alien_crystals.confirmed_gameplay_use: They can be used as Rock-It Launcher ammunition because DLC05MZ1QuestScript adds both crystal forms to RockItLauncherAmmo.
alien_crystals.anti_overfit: Crystal presence near technology is suggestive of technical use but does not establish power-source, memory-storage, communication, or mystical function.

abomination_forensics.physical_description: Large pale humanlike creatures with black eyes, morphologically described as human/Zetan-like chimeric forms.
human_input_evidence: Log 19 states the escapee's conclusion that humans are being changed into abominations and that many die in the experiments.
Frank is identified as a formerly human captive transformed into an abomination.
Log 10 records Frank after the procedure as growling while his companion reacts in horror.
Log 9 records an invasive procedure followed by growling/grunting, consistent with but not uniquely proving transformation.
abomination_forensics.key_inference: Because abominations are hostile to Zetans as well as humans, shipped behavior does not support treating them as a successfully obedient Zetan soldier caste.

canonical_lines_ru: «This was the spot where the birthday stuff would pop up» и «happy place objects are swapped» сохраняются как буквальные production-residue ключи.
Самая сильная скрытая связь здесь пока не криптографическая: боль alien examination должна была пересекаться с happy-place birthday imagery.
Четыре шапочки на десятилетии и четыре party hats на Zeta — настоящий числовой объектный параллель, но не один FormID.
Пришельцы умеют сохранять жизнь, но сохранение жизни не означает признание свободы.
Abominations показывают предел этой системы: эксперимент может поддерживать субъект достаточно долго для процедуры и при этом разрушать его тело и идентичность.
Кристаллы реальны как alien objects, но их lore-функция пока должна оставаться UNKNOWN.
